challenges.starter_code: select id,total from orders where status='paid' order by created_at desc
challenges.reference_solution:
-- Retrieve paid orders ordered from newest to oldest
SELECT
  id,
  total
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

es.title: Clean & Document: Consulta SQL legible
es.prompt: Formatea palabras clave en mayúsculas, separa cláusulas y añade comentario de propósito.
es.hint: Usa SELECT, FROM, WHERE y ORDER BY en líneas separadas y termina con `;`.

en.title: Clean & Document: Readable SQL Query
en.prompt: Uppercase SQL keywords, split clauses onto lines, and add a purpose comment.
en.hint: Put SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY on separate lines and end with `;`.

pt-BR.title: Clean & Document: Consulta SQL legível
pt-BR.prompt: Use palavras-chave em maiúsculas, separe cláusulas e adicione comentário.
pt-BR.hint: Coloque SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY em linhas separadas e termine com `;`.

pt-PT.title: Clean & Document: Consulta SQL legível
pt-PT.prompt: Use palavras-chave em maiúsculas, separe cláusulas e adicione comentário.
pt-PT.hint: Coloque SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY em linhas separadas e termine com `;`.

fr.title: Clean & Document : Requête SQL lisible
fr.prompt: Mettez les mots-clés en majuscules, séparez les clauses et ajoutez un commentaire.
fr.hint: Placez SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY sur des lignes distinctes et terminez par `;`.

de.title: Clean & Document: Lesbare SQL-Abfrage
de.prompt: SQL-Schlüsselwörter großschreiben, Klauseln umbrechen und Kommentar ergänzen.
de.hint: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY trennen und mit `;` abschließen.

it.title: Clean & Document: Query SQL leggibile

it.hint: Metti SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY su righe separate e chiudi con `;`.

es.title: Clean & Document: JSON RFC 8259 estricto

es.hint: JSON no permite comas antes de `]` o `}`.

en.title: Clean & Document: Strict RFC 8259 JSON

en.hint: JSON forbids trailing commas before `]` or `}`.

pt-BR.title: Clean & Document: JSON RFC 8259 estrito

pt-BR.hint: JSON não permite vírgula antes de `]` ou `}`.

pt-PT.title: Clean & Document: JSON RFC 8259 estrito

pt-PT.hint: JSON não permite vírgula antes de `]` ou `}`.

fr.title: Clean & Document : JSON RFC 8259 strict
fr.prompt: Supprimez les virgules finales invalides et formatez sur 2 espaces.
fr.hint: JSON interdit les virgules avant `]` ou `}`.

de.title: Clean & Document: Striktes RFC-8259-JSON

it.title: Clean & Document: JSON RFC 8259 rigoroso
it.prompt: Rimuovi le virgole finali non valide e formatta con 2 spazi.
it.hint: JSON vieta le virgole prima di `]` o `}`.
